primitives.verbatim_quote: The method of claim 23 wherein the method further includes the step of communicating with said inertial navigation module using ZigBee specification.
primitives.assumptions: Linear motion approximation, constant angular rate during integration intervals.

primitives.name: Global Positioning System State Refiner
primitives.verbatim_quote: The method of claim 23 wherein a global positioning system module is connected to the object and the method further includes the step of using data provided by said global positioning system module for determining the object state at certain time.
primitives.assumptions: Satellite line-of-sight availability, minimal atmospheric delay.

These components form a hierarchical Bayesian network where each modality contributes posterior beliefs about object state. Inertial measurements provide high-frequency updates but suffer from drift; GPS offers sparse yet accurate corrections; visual inputs enhance robustness against environmental noise. The system operates under a Kalman-like update mechanism that fuses these streams dynamically based on reliability metrics. Failure modes include sensor malfunctions, communication delays, and environmental obstructions. Dualities arise between deterministic kinematic models and stochastic uncertainty propagation. The architecture supports recursive inference with temporal consistency constraints.
